helper:
Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
